predecessors.text: the northern Wa area round Pangkham (Panghsang), a 90 km circle cut to Shan State; the page gives the total as 'approximately 27,000' km2 (infobox 30,000), of which the south is 13,000, leaving about…

ledger.x: 1989: the Wa State begins on 17 April.
1996: the Wa move into the Thai-border country of the Mong Tai Army.
2024: Hopang and Pan Lon pass to Wa State.

wars.name: UWSA-Mong Tai Army fighting
wars.outcome: 'Until 1996, the Mong Tai Army was also fighting the United Wa State Army'; after the MTA's collapse the UWSA occupied two large swathes of territory near the Thai border.

certainty.note: A de facto autonomous region with a ceasefire (UWSA and the junta, 18 May 1989 per the text, 9 May per the infobox) and no published boundary; the Hopang transfer of January 2024 is the one dated line.
